fact: 1948年6月24日苏联切断西柏林与西方占领区之间的陆路与水路交通，柏林封锁开始；西方三国立即决定通过空运维持西柏林210万居民的供应，空运持续到1949年5月12日苏联解除封锁。

sources.title: Berlin Airlift — The National Archives, UK
sources.quote: The Airlift officially ended on 30 September 1949, 15 months after its protracted beginnings in June 1948. In total, the United States and Britain delivered 1,783,573 and 541,937 tons respectively, from 277,569 flights to Berlin.

sources.title: Airlift airport Tempelhof — Flughafen Tempelhof
sources.quote: Between 26 June 1948 and 6 October 1949, with almost 278,000 flights, more than 2.3 million tons of freight was transported: Food, coal, machines, equipment and other goods of daily need for the supply of 2.1 million people in West-Berlin.

fact: 1948年5月14日本-古里安在特拉维夫宣读《以色列国独立宣言》；次日埃及、约旦、叙利亚、伊拉克、黎巴嫩五国军队入侵，第一次中东战争爆发。

sources.title: The Declaration of the Establishment of the State of Israel — Israel Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.quote: On May 14, 1948, on the day in which the British Mandate over a Palestine expired, the Jewish People's Council gathered at the Tel Aviv Museum, and approved the following proclamation, declaring the establishment of a Jewish state in Eretz-Israel.

fact: 1948年4月3日杜鲁门签署《1948年对外援助法》（Foreign Assistance Act of 1948, 62 Stat. 137），马歇尔计划正式立法实施；美国在1948-1952年向16个欧洲国家提供约130亿美元援助。

sources.title: Foreign Assistance Act of 1948, 62 Stat. 137 — US Government Publishing Office (GovInfo)
sources.quote: An Act To promote world peace and the general welfare, national interest, and foreign policy of the United States through economic, financial, and other measures necessary to the maintenance of conditions abroad in which free institutions may survive and consistent with the maintenance of the strength and welfare of the United States. Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, That this Act may be cited as the "Foreign Assistance Act of 1948."

fact: 1948年2月捷克斯洛伐克共产党在苏联支持下发动政变，迫使非共部长辞职，哥特瓦尔德政府成为完全的共产党政权；这一事件推动西欧加速军事合作，1948年3月布鲁塞尔条约签订。

sources.title: Czechoslovak Coup, February 1948 — US State Department, Office of the Historian
sources.quote: The Czechoslovak coup in February 1948 brought that country fully into the Soviet bloc and removed any prospect of Czechoslovak participation in the European Recovery Program.

fact: 1948年8月19日国民党政府在上海发布金圆券改革，300万法币兑1金圆券，强制收兑民间黄金、白银与外币；11月后金圆券恶性贬值，到1949年5月上海解放时形同废纸。

sources.title: China's 1947-1949 Hyperinflation — Planet Banknote
sources.quote: On 19 August 1948 the Nationalist government replaced the fabi with the gold yuan certificate at 3,000,000 fabi to one gold yuan, pegged it at four gold yuan to the US dollar, capped the total issue at two billion units, and required residents to surrender privately held gold, silver and foreign currency.

sources.title: Hyper Inflated — The World of Chinese
sources.quote: On August 19, 1948, the Nationalist government announced it would issue a new currency called the gold yuan, which would be pegged to the US dollar.

fact: 1948年6月20日西方占领区实行货币改革，德意志马克（DM）取代帝国马克；每个公民获得40 DM「人头补贴」，储蓄按100:6.5兑换；苏联随后在东柏林发行 Ost-DM，柏林分裂为两个货币区。

sources.title: Währungsreform und Berlin-Blockade — Bundesarchiv
sources.quote: Mit dem Inkrafttreten der Währungsreform erhielt jeder Bürger in den Westlichen Besatzungszonen am 20. Juni 1948 40 D-Mark, sogenanntes „Kopfgeld“. Ein Tag später, am 21. Juni 1948, wurde die D-Mark zum alleinigen Zahlungsmittel. Gesparte Guthaben in Reichsmark wurden im Verhältnis 100:6,5 umgestellt.

sources.title: The economic and currency reform of 1948 — Deutsche Bundesbank
sources.quote: Their key laws, enacted by the occupying powers, enter into force on 20 June 1948. The Deutsche Mark replaces the Reichsmark in the three western zones.

fact: 1948年12月10日联合国大会在巴黎夏乐宫以第217A(III)号决议通过《世界人权宣言》（Universal Declaration of Human Rights）；这是联合国首次在全球范围内系统表述基本人权。

sources.title: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights — United Nations
sources.quote: The Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR) is a milestone document in the history of human rights. Drafted by representatives with different legal and cultural backgrounds from all regions of the world, the Declaration sets out fundamental human rights to be universally protected. It was adopted by the UN General Assembly on 10 December 1948.

fact: 1948年7月1日贝尔实验室在纽约召开记者招待会，正式向公众公布1947年12月发明的点接触式晶体管（transistor）；这一发明后来成为整个半导体与电子工业的基础，1956年肖克利、巴丁、布拉顿因此获诺贝尔物理学奖。

sources.title: John Bardeen — National Inventors Hall of Fame
sources.quote: John Bardeen, Walter Brattain and William Shockley invented the first working transistor at Bell Labs in 1947, announced to the public on July 1, 1948.

fact: 1948年1月30日圣雄甘地在德里比尔拉宅邸被印度教民族主义者纳图拉姆·戈德塞刺杀；甘地的遇刺引发全国哀悼与教派暴力的短暂降温。

sources.title: Mahatma Gandhi — National Archives of India
sources.quote: Mahatma Gandhi was assassinated on 30 January 1948 in Birla House, New Delhi, by Nathuram Godse.

fact: 1948年4月7日《世界卫生组织组织法》在获得26个联合国会员国批准后正式生效，世界卫生组织（WHO）成立，总部设在日内瓦。

sources.title: History of WHO — World Health Organization
sources.quote: The Constitution of the World Health Organization was adopted by the International Health Conference held in New York from 19 June to 22 July 1946 and signed on 22 July 1946 by the representatives of 61 States. It entered into force on 7 April 1948, when the 26th member had ratified it.
